mugRefinements.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Clean up this transparent mug cutout. The background and handle opening must be completely alpha-transparent. Keep only the ceramic mug with a smooth precise antialiased silhouette. Preserve the mug and red emblem exactly as shown; no changes to product or printed design. Keep square framing and size. mugRefinements.prompt: Produce a pristine professional e-commerce cutout of the provided ceramic mug for a dark-background dashboard. Use case background-extraction. Edit target is the supplied original product photograph. Extract ONLY the full ceramic mug, including its handle. Transparent background required with true alpha. Smooth precise silhouette; no outside white specks or shadow debris whatsoever, no ragged pixel edges. The opening inside the handle is entirely transparent. All ceramic including bright white highlights remains fully opaque. Retain the same camera angle, mug shape, and exact printed red emblem. No floor, no shadow, no props. Square image with centered mug and breathing room. Inspect against dark teal: all edges must be clean and polished.
